publication.title: A marginal marine fauna from the upper Dinosaur Park Formation, Canada
authors: A. M. Murray, D. B. Brinkman, R. B. Holmes

locality.name: PBDB collection 276674: East of Dinosaur Provincial Park in the Lethbridge Coal Zone, near Iddesleigh, Alberta. "The study area is on private land along the southern bank of the Red Deer River, about 6 km east of the provincial park boundary. We defined 21 sites, each of which represents an approximately 100 m stretch along the length of the exposed outcrop." [Paper does not separate taxa by site, so all are lumped and coordinates based on site L, the richest site]

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 276674 to Late Campanian with numeric bounds 83.6–72.2 Ma.
age.notes: Database-derived occurrence snapshot from Paleobiology Database reference 93834; not yet re-verified against the publication full text.

claims.summary: PBDB occurrence 2048118 records Ornithopoda in collection 276674, linked by PBDB to reference 93834.
PBDB stores the original/identified name as Ornithopoda indet. and the accepted name as Ornithopoda.
